source: ECC/ERC Recommendation T/R 25-08, edition 6 June 2025 (https://docdb.cept.org/download/4789), Annex 1 section A1.2.3; values unchanged since the 28 September 2018 edition
scope: Land mobile systems 29.7-470 MHz. Indicative coordination thresholds: co-channel, 50 % of locations, 10 % of time, 10 m receiving antenna height, reference bandwidth 25 kHz, at the border line.
unit: dB(uV/m) per 25 kHz at 10 m height
bandwidth_correction: For channel spacing greater than 25 kHz with uniform spectral power distribution: BC = 10 * log10(channel_spacing_kHz / 25) dB is added to the threshold (A1.2.3). Otherwise the threshold applies within every 25 kHz of the channel.

wideband_annex3.note: Annex 3, Table 1: partial overlap between narrowband (up to 25 kHz) and wideband (channel > 1 MHz) systems, field strength at 10 m height.
wideband_annex3.narrowband_preferential_regime_a: 20 dBuV/m/25 kHz at 40 km beyond the border line
wideband_annex3.narrowband_preferential_regime_b: 20 dBuV/m/25 kHz at 50 km beyond the border line
wideband_annex3.narrowband_non_preferential: 20 dBuV/m/25 kHz at 0 km (on the border line)
wideband_annex3.wideband_regime_a: 41 dBuV/m/25 kHz at 0 km (on the border line)
wideband_annex3.wideband_regime_b: 48 dBuV/m/25 kHz at 0 km (on the border line)

wideband_annex4_lte_cdma_400mhz.note: Annex 4: FDD LTE/CDMA in 410-430 / 450-470 MHz, mean field strength per 5 MHz at 3 m height. A height correction of 10 dB between 10 m and 3 m may be used for practical purposes (Annex 3).

propagation_model: ITU-R P.1546 (land/sea/mixed paths, 10 % time, 50 % locations, 10 m receiving height) as required by the challenge brief.
